chapter.verse: Tua khitzawh, uktheihna lianpi a nei vanmi a dang khat vantung panin hong paisuk ka mu a, leitung pen ama' minphatna vang tawh taang hi.

Tua ciangin awging khauhpi tawh hih bangin kiko hi: “Babylon khuapi lian, puk ta, puk ta! Dawite' tenna mun suak ta a, kha nin citeng' bualna kua, vasa nin citeng' zualna kua, sapi a nin a kihhuai citeng' kualna kua suak ta hi.

A hang pen minam khempeuh in ama' bawl nulepa tatkhialhna tawh kisai lungsona lengtui kham khin uh a, leitung kumpite in amah tawh nulepa tatkhialhna bawlin leitung sumbawlte ama' cilesa noptatna vang tawh hauhlawh uh hi.”
Tua ciangin vantung pan awging dang khat hih bangin ka za hi: “Ka mite aw, ama' kiangpan hong paikhia un, tua hikeileh ama' mawhna na sukha ding uh a, ama' gimpina na thuakpihkha ding uh hi.
A hang pen ama' mawhna teng vantung dong kiciangto a, ama' diklohna teng Pasian in phawk gige hi.
Midangte' tungah a lohkik bangin ama' tungah zong lohkik un. Ama' sepkhiatte a zah nihin dinkik un. Ama' lengtui hai sungah a zah nih-a khauh lengtui sungsuk un.

Amahmah kisanglapin cilesa a noptat zah khatin gawtna leh tauna a zah kibang khat pia un. A hang pen amah in a lungsim sungah, ‘Kumpinu hihna tawh ka tu hi, meigong numei ka hikei hi, tauna ka tuak ngeikei ding hi,’ ci hi.
Hih thu hangin ni khat sungin ama' gimpina hong tung ding a, sihna, tauna leh kialpi hiding hi. Tua ciangin mei tawh amah kihaltum ding hi. A hang pen ama' tunga thukhen Topa Pasian a thahat ahi hi.”
Tua ciangin amah tawh nulepa tatkhialhna a bawl, cilesa noptatna a nei leitung kumpite zong amah a kihalna meikhu a muh uh ciangin kapin tam lo ding uh hi.

Ama' thuak gawtna kihta uh ahih manin a gamla ah dingin hih bangin ci ding uh hi: “Ala! Ala! Nang khuapi lian, Nang Babylon, a thahat khuapi! Nai khat sung bekbekin na tungah thukhenna hong tung hita hi.”
Tua ciangin leitung sumbawlte a vante uh kuamah in lei nawnlo ding ahih manin Babylon hangin kapin mau uh hi.
A vante cih ciangin kham, ngun, suangmanpha, kep, puannel, puan sandum, naipuan, puan san, singnamtui namkim, saiha tawh kibawl van namkim, citron sing tawh kibawl van namkim, sumngo, sik, suangngo,
thaksing, amomum tehnamtui, paknamtui, singnai paknamtui, lingnai paknamtui, lengtui, sathau, annelvui, mangbuh, gante leh tuute, sakolte leh gankaih leengte, silate leh salte, cih teng ahi hi.
(“Na nunna kha sunga na lunggulh singgah nang' kiangpan lalthang khinta, nangma' vanzat nopcite leh nangma' vanzat manphate zong a vekin nang' kiangpan thelthang khinta, muhkik ngeiloh ding hita!”)
Tua ciangin Babylon' hanga a hauhlawh, hih vante a zuak sumbawlte zong Babylon' thuak gawtna kihta uh ahih manin a gamla ah ding ding uh a, hih bangin kapin mau ding uh hi:
“Ala! Ala! Khuapi lian, puannel a silh, a sandum leh a san a silh, kham tawh a kizem, suangmanpha leh kep tawh a kizem!
Nai khat sung bekbekin hih hauhna khempeuh kisia khin zen maw!” Tua ciangin tembaw ukte, tuipi tunga khualzinte, tembaw nasemte leh tuipi tungah nuntakzon nasep a neite, a vekun a gamla ah ding uh a,
Babylon a katna meikhu a muh uh ciangin hih bangin kiko uh hi: “Hih khuapi lian tawh a kibang khuapi a om hiam?”

Tua ciangin amaute kap kawmin a lu tung uhah leivui theh uh a, hih bangin kiko uh hi: “Ala! Ala! Khuapi lian, tuipi tembaw a neite khempeuh ama' neihlelam hangin a hauhna uh mun! Nai khat sung bekbekin a kisia khin hita hi.
Vantung aw, ama' hangin lungdam in. No mi siangthote, sawltakte leh kamsangte zong lungdam un. A hang pen Pasian in no hong cihna-in Babylon' tungah thukhenna pia khin hi.”

Tua ciangin vanmi a thahat khat in angawina suang tawh a kibang suangtum khat la-in tuipi sungah lawnsuk a, hih bangin ci hi: “Khuapi lian Babylon zong nakpi-in kilawnsuk ding a, kimukha nawnlo ding hi.

Harp khausai siamte, la sate, tamngai tumte leh pengkul tumte' awging, nang' kiangah kizakha nawnlo ding a, nasep khatpeuh-a khutsiam mite zong nang' kiangah kimukha nawnlo-in angawina suang ging zong nang' kiangah kizakha nawnlo ding hi.

Meivak pana meitaang in nang hong taan nawnlo ding a, zipi tangval leh mo nungak a awging nang' kiangah kizakha nawnlo ding hi. A hang pen nangma' sumbawlte leitunga milian teng hi a, minam khempeuh in nangma' mibumna aitawi tawh khemna tuak uh hi.
Ama' sungah kamsangte leh mi siangthote' sisan kimu a, leitunga thahlup a thuak mite khempeuh' sisan zong om hi.”
